name: 旧购物车货笼
prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. A salvaged supermarket wire shopping trolley, rusty gray tubular frame, dark green repaired handle, small wheels, two bundled parcels and one worn canvas bag inside wire basket. Ground .85x.70tile, height45px at tile144. True hand-painted bold contour style with only enough mesh to read at small size, no photoreal wire noise. No extra floor or base. Full unsearched. Absolutely NO halo, NO surrounding glow, NO semi-transparent smoky background. Outside the hard object silhouette must be fully transparent.
